## Mobix Labs Secures Follow-On Order Exceeding $1 Million for Threat-Detection Sensor Subsystems


September 17, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.mobixlabs.com/node/9516/pdf)


*Multi-unit production order from a leading security-technology provider supports a next-generation screening platform for a U.S. government program*


IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026--[Mobix Labs, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fmobixlabs.com%2F&esheet=54605170&newsitemid=20260915045292&lan=en-US&anchor=Mobix+Labs%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=3696b79be93f248404e17568afcec830) (Nasdaq: MOBX), a U.S.-based supplier of advanced connectivity and sensing solutions for national security, today announced that it has received a multi-unit follow-on production order in excess of $1 million for advanced RF sensing subsystems from a leading security-technology provider. The order, placed with the company’s[RaGE Systems division](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fragesystems.com%2F&esheet=54605170&newsitemid=20260915045292&lan=en-US&anchor=RaGE+Systems+division&index=2&md5=b0e9e90b9e8a0472b45e9d512cd1504a) , supports a U.S. government security program focused on detecting concealed threats.


The Mobix Labs units are self-contained sensing subsystems that serve as the “eyes” of the customer’s next-generation threat-detection platform. Multiple units are integrated into each platform, where they capture the raw sensor data the customer’s detection software uses to identify concealed metallic and non-metallic threats. This order follows previous production orders and reflects growing worldwide demand for advanced threat-detection platforms, in which these sensors are a critical component.


“This is exactly the kind of win RaGE Systems was built to deliver,” said Phil Sansone, Chief Executive Officer of Mobix Labs. “A demanding customer trusted us to design a complex sensing subsystem; we proved it out, and now they have come back with a production order in excess of $1 million. Every one of these units will help protect people and critical assets, and because multiple units go into every system our customer fields, we see this as the continuation of a long-term production relationship rather than a one-time order.”


The subsystems are designed and manufactured in the United States, drawing on Mobix Labs’ expertise in wideband RF receivers, transmitters, and multi-function assemblies for defense and security applications.


Demand for advanced threat-detection technology continues to grow as government and commercial security operators seek faster, more accurate detection with fewer false alarms across a wide range of secure environments.

**About Mobix Labs, Inc.**
